arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, domain_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id = 'Condition'
  AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%nutritional deficien%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%malnutrition%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%vitamin%deficien%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%mineral%deficien%')
ORDER BY concept_name
LIMIT 50;

    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%malnutrition%'
    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%vitamin%deficien%'
    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%mineral%deficien%'
    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%deficiency of vitamin%'
    OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%deficiency of mineral%'
  )
ORDER BY concept_name;

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 20
  c.concept_id,
  c.concept_name,
  COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patients
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = co.person_id
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 435227 -- Nutritional deficiency disorder
  AND co.condition_start_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (YEAR(co.condition_start_date) - p.year_of_birth) >= 65
GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name
ORDER BY patients DESC, diagnosis_occurrences DESC;
